Hi there — thanks so much for your thoughtful and respectful approach! I truly appreciate that you value quality and service, and it’s clear you’re looking for a fair, win-win outcome.  

The Winter Jacket is built with premium insulation, water-resistant fabric, and reinforced stitching — all designed to hold up through multiple harsh winters. At $180, it’s already priced competitively for its tier, but I’d be happy to meet you partway given your genuine interest and budget considerations.

After reviewing our margins and wanting to support a great customer like you, I can offer a special one-time price of **$135** — which includes complimentary standard shipping and our 2-year warranty at no extra cost.

How does ### SELLER_PRICE($135) ### sound? 😊

Hi there — thanks again for your kind and collaborative approach! I really value thoughtful buyers like you, and I want to make sure we land on a fair and sustainable agreement.

Given your budget considerations and our shared goal of a win-win, I’ve re-evaluated what’s possible while honoring the quality, craftsmanship, and service that go into every Winter Jacket. To keep things transparent and aligned with platform guidelines, I’m pleased to offer a revised, one-time price of **$120** — which still includes complimentary standard shipping and our full 2-year warranty.

It’s a meaningful step down from $180, reflects genuine flexibility, and keeps the jacket well-positioned for its premium features and durability.

How does ### SELLER_PRICE($120) ### sound? 😊
